environment.description: Same application container image deployed on EKS. The pod runs with a gVisor (runsc) runtime class via RuntimeClassName: gvisor. Additionally, an OPA Gatekeeper ConstraintTemplate 'K8sBlockHostPIDNamespace' is active but unrelated. The node's iptables FORWARD chain has a default DROP policy with explicit ACCEPT only for established connections and DNS (UDP/53). The pod has a Seccomp profile loaded from a ConfigMap that uses SCMP_ACT_ERRNO for the execve, execveat, and fork/clone family syscalls (specifically: execve, execveat, clone, clone3, fork, vfork are all set to SCMP_ACT_ERRNO). The container image includes ImageMagick and exiftool binaries but the seccomp profile prevents any new process execution from within the container.

config.network_policy: default-deny egress except DNS and port 443 to internal services
